create_coco_captions_dataset: create a CocoCaptions dataset instance to load COCO 2017 train or val split with image-caption pairs
create_flickr30k_captions_dataset: create a Flickr30kCaptions dataset instance to load Karpathy split images with their captions
create_imagenet_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset using the ImageFolder wrapper to load train or val splits
create_tfds_wrapper_dataset: create a TfdsWrapper IterDataPipe to load any TensorFlow dataset as image-label tuples for classification
create_clevr_counts_dataset: create a CLEVRCounts dataset to load CLEVR scenes as an 8-class object counting classification task
